security_id: opaque deterministic ID derived from exchange, immutable lifecycle anchor and original listing date; never a source symbol
identity_anchor: first independently documented exchange symbol paired with provider or official listing date
symbol_aliases: one stable security_id may have multiple date-effective symbols; aliases must come from a versioned source contract
code_reuse: the same exchange symbol on distinct non-overlapping lifecycle listing dates receives distinct security_id values
unknown_policy: missing or conflicting lifecycle identity yields null security_id and an explicit unresolved reason
